items.question: What alternative materials are prescribed for the installation of the liṅga?
premises: The verse lists several material options in the locative case.
The options include image, stone-made, unbaked, baked, wooden, and jewel-born forms.
Disjunctive particles indicate that these materials are alternatives.
items.inference: The liṅga may be installed in any of the specified alternative materials.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'bere' as image or painted form is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: It may be installed in an image, in something made of stone, in unbaked or baked material, or else in wood or in something made of jewels.
